title: Etale morphisms become finite etale on a constructible stratification
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $j:U\to X$ be an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] with $U$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Then there exists a finite partition $X=\coprod_i X_i$ by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-weil-constructible-subset] such that each base change $U_i:=U\times_X X_i\to X_i$ is finite etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. The fibre products are those of [def-pc-fibre-product]. This is Stacks Project Lemma 59.70.8, Tag 03S9 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite).
